record.question:
Change the speech of the following sentences :
(a) The little boy told his mother that he was hungry.
(b) The man asked me where I lived.
(c) The teacher said, “All men are mortal.”
(d) Father said, “Mother will be home soon.”
(e) The king ordered the servant to bring his crown.
(f) The man says, “It was very cold in the morning.”
(g) The little girl exclaimed with joy that it was a pretty doll.
(h) The boy will say, “The servant has broken the vase.”
(i) Mawia said, “I have finished my work.”
(j) The boy begged his father to buy him a new toy. (10×1=10)
